deductions.normal_frequencies: Failed to obtain the correct normal frequencies $\omega_1 = \sqrt{6}\omega_0$ and $\omega_2 = \sqrt{30}\omega_0$.
deductions.normal_modes_and_general_solution: Failed to obtain the correct normal modes and the correct general solution for $x(t)$ and $\theta(t)$.
deductions.stability_analysis: Incorrectly concluded that the equilibrium is unstable (it is stable).
